svg.aria-label: GeDefense Linux 6.3.0 Trust Domain Separation and 7-Tier Security Architecture
svg.text: GeDefense Linux 6.3.0 — Trust Domains & Security Data Flow
Privilege-separated architecture: unprivileged perimeter, loopback-only control plane, capability-split capture/parser helpers, static musl core & kernel eBPF/LSM
TRUST DOMAIN 1 · PUBLIC ACCESS GATEWAY (:9843)
Unprivileged `gedefense-access` · Go TLS 1.3 (ML-KEM PQ hybrid) · Argon2id · CSRF
RBAC (Observer / Operator / Critical Step-Up) · Signed `.gateway-claim` · Zero backend exposure
Native Web Dashboard: Vanilla JS/CSS · Strict CSP · Local GeoIP/jsVectorMap · 0 CDN
ISOLATED PRIVILEGED HELPERS (ZERO STATE ACCESS)
`gedefense-capture-helper`: CAP_NET_RAW + CAP_NET_ADMIN only · IPAddressDeny=any
Read-only AF_PACKET / CN_PROC records via SO_PEERCRED `capture.sock` (0600)
`gedefense-cell-helper`: Ephemeral seccomp/namespace parser cells (`burn after use`)
Loopback HTTPS/HTTP 127.0.0.1:9844 + Bearer + HMAC claim
Bounded read-only telemetry / burn-cell verdict
TRUST DOMAIN 2 · CONTROL PLANE (`gedefense-control` · `127.0.0.1:9844` · UID `gedefense` · 0 Linux Capabilities)
Host XDR & SBC Graph Fusion · Native L7 WAF (`inspect.sock`/`edge.sock`) · Policy & Release Gates (`Observe -> Canary -> Enforce`)
PermitV1 Broker · Ed25519 Monotone Evidence Ledger · AES-256-GCM FIM Baselines · 2-of-3 TUF Feed Guard · Out-of-Band Witness Push
Web-Evidence Isolation Barrier: Web L7 findings carry `AlertOnly: true` (`ResponseScore: 0`) — cannot trigger SIGKILL without independent host evidence
VGT3 Signed IPC (`/run/vgt-gedefense/core.sock` · HMAC-SHA-256 + timestamp + nonce + SO_PEERCRED)
TRUST DOMAIN 3 · PRIVILEGED RESPONSE CORE (`gedefense-core` · Static-PIE musl · 0 `NEEDED` · Root + Bounded Caps)
eBPF/LSM Map Pin Manager (`23 CRITICAL_MAPS`) · 8-Domain CrossView · Fanotify Exec/Write + Archive Scanner · AES-256-GCM Vault
`pidfd_open` Verified Tree Containment · Sysctl Compare-and-Set with Auto-Rollback · Zero generic shell interface
/sys/fs/bpf/gedefense + RingBuf (`FLOW_EVENTS` 16 MiB · `SEC_CRIT_EVENTS` 256 KiB)
TRUST DOMAIN 4 · KERNEL DATA PLANE (`gedefense-ebpf` · Rust `no_std`)
XDP Ingress (250k LPM rules before sk_buff) · cgroup_skb Ingress/Egress (StyX PCR) · BPF-LSM (bprm, mmap, file_open, bpf_prog, socket_create, ptrace, io_uring)
Ransom Kprobes (vfs_write/rename/unlink) · Kernel Module & DNS Tracepoints · BTF `exec_inode` Resolution · Optional Chameleon Symbol Renaming
